name: Line-side earthing-switch bay interface
summary: Shows the assigned earthing connection on the line side of the bay devices.
description: Shows the assigned earthing connection on the line side of the bay devices. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Isolated line section” at the input and “Line-side earthing connection” at the output. Remote sources must be considered by the operating scheme.
